descripcion_geo: Cultural and philosophical capital of the Greek world, seat of the Areopagus and the Acropolis.
importancia_estrategica: Intellectual center of the ancient world; city ​​with myriads of temples and philosophical schools.

historias.descripcion: Paul presents the gospel to the Stoic and Epicurean philosophers at the Areopagus.

historias.titulo: The altar to the unknown God
historias.descripcion: Paul cites the altar 'To the Unknown God' from Athens to introduce the creator God.
Some mock the resurrection; others ask for more information; some believe.

personajes.descripcion: He dialogued with Athenian philosophers; only evangelistic speech before a completely pagan audience.
Member of the Areopagus who believed after Paul's speech.
Woman who believed in the Areopagus; Tradition links it with the first Athenian church.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: City full of idols and temples; scene of the only debate of the gospel before the pagan intellectual elite.

cristianismo.descripcion: Paul uses the 'To the Unknown God' altar of Athens to proclaim the creator God, connecting the Greek religious quest with the gospel.
cristianismo.significado_teologico: Paul uses the 'To the Unknown God' altar of Athens to proclaim the creator God, connecting the Greek religious quest with the gospel.
